conversion_rules.evidence_snippet: The Conference of Ministers of Education and Cultural Affairs recommends the modified Bavarian formula as a practical basis for converting examination results.
conversion_rules.notes: Modified Bavarian formula: German grade = 1 + 3 x (Nmax - Nd) / (Nmax - Nmin). Nmin (lowest passing CGPA on your transcript) differs between universities, so a range of 1.0 to 2.0 is used until you enter your own. Add the official source URL and snippet before fit decisions use this rule.
